title: Rome Odunze clarifies "new normal" comment: "My foot feels amazing"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rome Odunze clarifies "new normal" comment: "My foot feels amazing"
sources.description: Bears receiver Rome Odunze raised some concerns about his foot when he told reporters during the offseason program that his “new normal” is going to be dealing with some sort of discomfort.
